package.json:overrides:typed-rest-client.reason: typed-rest-client pins qs exactly; Dependabot cannot move its child to a patched release. The originally proposed 6.15.2 still has two moderate advisories; 6.16.0 fixes all three current qs advisories.
package.json:overrides:typed-rest-client.removalCondition: Remove when the typed-rest-client version selected by Stryker declares a qs range admitting a patched release, and a regenerated lockfile and compatibility tests remain clean without the override.

package.json:overrides:exceljs:uuid.reason: ExcelJS requires the vulnerable uuid 8 range; Dependabot proposes downgrading ExcelJS instead of fixing its child. uuid 11 retains the CommonJS v4 API used by ExcelJS extended conditional formatting.
package.json:overrides:exceljs:uuid.removalCondition: Remove when ExcelJS declares a compatible patched uuid range, or ExcelJS is replaced, and the regenerated lockfile and conditional-formatting round trip pass without the override.

apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock:dismis.reason: The desktop shell ships Windows x64 only (ADR-014, recorded in apps/desktop/README.md). glib belongs to Tauri's Linux GTK dependency chain and is not built into the shipped target.
apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock:dismis.removalCondition: Reopen alert #14 and resolve the vulnerable GTK chain before planning, building or shipping a Linux desktop shell. The orchestrator dismisses the alert only after review.
